what:
frontend-tree: detach the build path from ide-db and hir-ide, so the syntax handle layer can be deleted.

Why: every build-path caller of the handle API is moved (frontend-tree-go-*). What is left is hir's handle Semantics, SourceAnalyzer, HasSource and symbols.rs, and the hir-expand/hir-def handle functions only they call (list: /tmp/blaze-lanes/v2-frontend-tree-go-expand.md, "IDE-only list"). They serve only ide-db and hir-ide. But those two crates are still build-path dependencies, so deleting the chain now would break the build:
- ide-db: blaze-cargo, blaze-engine, load-cargo, blaze-doc and blaze-wasm. They mostly use ide_db::base_db::* re-exports (Crate, all_crates, relevant_crates, Env, process_env_var, salsa::Cancelled), which can import from base_db directly. Beyond that: ide_db::RootDatabase (blaze-engine 15, blaze-doc 7, blaze-wasm 1), which becomes base_db::Db, and ide_db::const_macro::{load, CONST_AST} (load-cargo, see also queue 00187).
- hir-ide: hir (next_solver Mutability, Clause, TraitClause, Span::Dummy, mir::MirSpan, replace_errors_with_variables, type_or_const_param_idx).
- blaze-engine/src/lib.rs callers_of_generic takes its callers from ide_db::defs::Definition::usages, so it needs a build-path caller index.

Ask: at integration, (1) move those imports off ide-db and hir-ide, (2) delete crates/ide-db and crates/hir-ide, (3) hand back to frontend-tree. frontend-tree then deletes hir's handle Semantics chain, the IDE-only hir-expand/hir-def functions, and the handle layer in syntax/syntax-tree in one pass. Their reference tests become stored expectations. Until then no new code may call that chain.

history.note: ide-db deleted (git rm crates/ide-db, root Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, blaze-wasm Cargo.lock). Users moved: ide_db::base_db -> base_db, RootDatabase -> base_db::Db, RootDatabaseExt -> db.files().X / krate.set_env / change.apply(db), const_macro -> hir::const_macro (hir_ty_mir::const_macro); callers_of_generic needed no new index (by_references oracle dropped, stored expectations kept); as_rustc known_feature by integrate-engine (00984). blaze-lints (00283) has no ide_db use. macros UpmapFromRaFixture derive and hir ConstParam::default_source_code deleted with it. hir-ide deleted too (code in hir-ty / hir-ty-mir, tests in hir-ty-mir/src/tests).
